description: Update shippingCost and/or additionalCost for rates in a shipping rate table (Account API v2 updateShippingCost). Pass rateTableId (from ebay_get_rate_tables) and rateTableUpdate.rates[] with each rateId (from ebay_get_rate_table). Returns success (eBay 204 No Content). Rate tables are supported on US, CA, GB, DE, AU, FR, IT and ES. Requires sell.account.

rateTableId.description: Shipping rate table ID (from Account API v1 getRateTables)

rates.description: Rate objects whose shippingCost and/or additionalCost change

additionalCost.description: New additional cost (WEIGHT per-unit or SURCHARGE rate table basis)

rateId.description: Rate ID from the rate table (Account API v1 ebay_get_rate_tables)

shippingCost.description: New base shipping rate (ITEM or WEIGHT rate table basis)

value.description: Monetary amount as a decimal string, e.g. "2.50"

name: ebay_update_rate_table_shipping_cost
